title: Fixing Apple's Engineering in an Hour
summary: Linus Tech Tips water-cools a 2020 MacBook Air, tearing it down and showing the cooling design along the way. The video shows the gap between the CPU lid and die and how little the stock heatsink does.
why: Cited in Apple thermal-design debates as evidence the Intel-era MacBook cooling was poor.

quote.text: It's a fairly entertaining video, the things they try but that gap, the entire cooling solution actually, are a little hard to understand.
